content:
Last month, Anthropic announced the expansion of Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad. This rollout initially started with Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic stated that Claude Cowork has been fully rolled out to mobile and desktop versions across all paid plans.

You can learn more details about the release of the Anthropic Claude Cowork mobile version here.

On the other hand, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, called ChatGPT Work, which also supports iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web versions.

Make the most of your Apple products
